payload.name: Extract Object Descriptions from Referenced-Item Exchanges
payload.description: Use during extraction when one speaker asks about or comments on an object the other speaker just showed or mentioned, and the reply identifies or describes that object.
content: During extraction, when a speaker refers to an object with a demonstrative or pronoun ('this map', 'that picture', 'it') and the other speaker replies by identifying or describing the object, resolve the referent from the prior turn and create a candidate memory for the object and its description.

If the exchange shows the object was shown or shared, record an event memory with the sharer, the recipient, and the object identity; otherwise record a state memory for the owner/object only if ownership is explicit.
Do not require the object name to be repeated in the reply; use the preceding question or comment as context to identify the object.
Emit at most one memory per such exchange unless the reply states additional distinct facts about a different subject.

solves: Conversations where an object is shown or mentioned and then identified only in a reply to a follow-up question are missed because the subject is expressed by a demonstrative or pronoun. This skill makes extraction resolve the referent across turns so showing/sharing events and object descriptions are stored.
